evidence.quote: Brightline would separately pay up to $3.5 million in court-approved fees and expenses; any amount not awarded would go to the class rather than Brightline.
Brightline proposes a $30 million class fund plus up to $3 million in court-approved fees and expenses.
We accept Brightline’s latest term sheet: a $30 million class fund with automatic distribution, plus up to $3 million in court-approved fees and expenses

summary: Plaintiff first raised fees in its opening proposal, and the parties negotiated fee amounts before the class relief was finally accepted. The record does not show any explicit tradeoff between fees and class recovery, plaintiff-side self-interest, defense leveraging fee interests, reverse-auction tactics, or a misleading declaration.
